The '''H'Drachi Seers''' were a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[H'drachi]] based on [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]]. By examining the [[time-stream]], they were able to [[Force vision/Legends|foresee]] events before they occurred.
